description: This Scala source file defines the OrcFileOperator object, which provides methods for reading ORC file schemas and data, handling file system interactions, and supporting parallel schema reading, primarily used within Spark SQL's Hive integration.

methods.name: getFileReader
methods.description: Retrieves an ORC file reader from a specified path, attempting to find a file with a non-empty schema.

methods.name: readSchema
methods.description: Infers the schema from a list of ORC file paths by opening the first valid file.

methods.name: readOrcSchemasInParallel
methods.description: Reads schemas from multiple ORC files concurrently using multithreading.

methods.name: getObjectInspector
methods.description: Gets the ObjectInspector for a given file path, if available.

methods.name: listOrcFiles
methods.description: Lists all ORC files in a directory, filtering out hidden and temporary files.
